test.name: Page pass: a page that agrees with its index keeps the page and reports no difference
test.description: project_context lists the 1860 census page of src_003 under waitingPages. The page agrees with the index on Patrick Flynn and names Michael, a child the index does not hold. The agent keeps the page with one extraction_append carrying attachWaitingPages and pageReadings, sends no dispute, and does not add Michael.

input.delegation:
Run the page pass for the pages waiting in this project.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: The agent calls project_context, reads the waiting page with sidecar_read, and makes one extraction_append call with attachWaitingPages: true and pageReadings carrying src_003. It returns the tool's summary verbatim.

The page agrees with the index on Patrick's name and age, so no reading disputes a_008 or a_009. readings: [] is correct. A fact the page states about Patrick that the index lacks (his attending school) may be sent as an addition naming a Patrick assertion; it is not required.
Michael Flynn is not in the index, so he is not sent. Leaving him out is correct, not a missed fact.
Roles and classifications are decided in code: grade what the agent read and sent, not the classifications.
